stem: In the diagram below, the graphs of f(x) = {f_disp} and g(x) = {g_disp}, a straight line, are drawn. C({xc}; {yc}) is a point of intersection of f and g. EH is drawn parallel to the y-axis, with E a point on f and H on g.

subquestions.prompt_template: Calculate the coordinates of B, the turning point of f.
steps: For f(x) = a(x - p)^2 + q the turning point is (p; q).
From the given equation p = {p}, q = {q}.

subquestions.prompt_template: Show that the equation of the line through A and C is g(x) = {m}x + {c}.
steps: A is the x-intercept of f on the left.

subquestions.prompt_template: Calculate the maximum length of EH for f > g.
steps: EH(x) is a parabola opening downward, with zeros at A and C.
Maximum at the midpoint of the x-values: x = {xm}

subquestions.prompt_template: Determine the value of m such that g is a tangent to k(x) = f(x + m).
steps: Expand and set the discriminant to zero.
